description: Ape Labs Neon Tube PIX (battery pixel tube, 32 pixels of red, green, blue and warm white, which is the W of the RGBW block). DMX comes through its built-in CRMX receiver or an Ape Labs CONNECT. The 32CH and 64CH modes have 8 and 16 pixels. Modes: 4CH, 7CH, 32CH, 64CH, 128CH; 128CH is the default. Built from the manual (this fixture is not in the Open Fixture Library) with the same conversion as the Open Fixture Library types.
